notice: Unreviewed draft: needs clinician review before live guidance.
description: Device kinds of the habitat simulator: what each low-cost sensor reports, its resolution, range, cadence, noise, drift and cross-sensitivity. Every number carries its basis; 'team assumption' marks values no source read here gives.

ndir_co2.label: NDIR CO2 module
ndir_co2.reports: CO2 mole fraction in ppm at one spot
ndir_co2.cannot_tell: ENVIRONMENTS.md section 2 and C25: reads ppm at one spot, needs the real cabin pressure to compare with the mmHg limit, misses local pockets.

o2_cell.label: Galvanic (electrochemical) oxygen cell with its own pressure sensor
